{"metadata":{"description":"Search, pin and hide models in DeepSeek Harness; refresh provider catalogues.","id":"gh:1351186337","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-model-picker-augmented","slug":"ManoloRemiddi/dsh-model-picker-augmented","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","manolo-dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Search, pin and hide models in DeepSeek Harness; refresh provider catalogues."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-model-picker-augmented"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> **MIT License** — Copyright (c) 2026 **Manolo Remiddi**
> SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT — see LICEN"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"SE for the full license text."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Searchable, curated composer model picker for DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"This plugin replaces the model picker in the composer with a searchable version
and adds a **Model P"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"icker Augmented** settings page so you can control exactly which
models appear in the list and which"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" ones are pinned to the top."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Live model search** — a search field at the top of the model list filters
as you type, matching "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"the model name **and** the provider name. Groups with
no matches disappear; an empty query restores "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"the full list.
- **Show / hide models** — hide models you never use from the picker list via
the set"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"tings page. Hidden models stay listed in Settings (marked *Hidden*)
so you can bring them back whene"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ver you want.
- **Pin to top** — pin your favorite models; they render in a *Pinned* section
at the "},{"id":"p7s6","text":"very top of the model list (and are removed from their provider group
below to avoid duplicates). Or"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"der them with the up/down arrows in Settings.
- **Refresh providers** — this button first forces
the"},{"id":"p7s8","text":" running harness to re-read `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` from disk, so
providers and models you added to t"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"he file **appear without restarting the
harness** — a new provider block in the file is served by th"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"e time the
refresh finishes. It then re-reads the live catalog and, for every active
provider that h"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"as a `baseURL`, checks the provider's endpoint and appends
any models the file does not list yet to "},{"id":"p7s12","text":"the provider's `models` list in
`settings.yaml` — a provider that has a `baseURL` but no `models` li"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"st yet
fills itself in with a single click, no hand-editing. If the file sync
itself fails, the refr"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"esh continues and reports it (`settings.yaml sync
failed: …`). The page also follows harness
catalog"},{"id":"p7s15","text":" changes pushed by the host (settings commits, adapter
re-registrations, credential updates), so the"},{"id":"p7s16","text":" view stays live.
- Keeps the rest of the picker exactly as shipped: the two-level Model/Effort
menu"},{"id":"p7s17","text":", effort levels, keyboard navigation, error/retry states, and full sync
with the `/model` command (b"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"oth use the same shared model directory)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) `>= 0.1.5-rc.1` (verified with 0.1.5-rc.1)
- The web GUI profile (`--prof"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ile web`), which ships the dependencies this
plugin builds on (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversat"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ion`,
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`,
`@deepsee"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"k-ai/dsh-client-locale`)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Install the tested **1.1.2** package directly from its GitHub release:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Restart DSH and reload its web page. This package is distributed through
GitHub Releases; it is not "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"published on npm. Existing users with a `link:`
installation should update their linked checkout to "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"tag `v1.1.2` instead
of adding a second copy. Keep your current settings and model credentials."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"For a source installation:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The plugin is a DSH bundle patch package (same pattern as other hot-pluggable
web plugins):"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"`pnpm install` matters: `link:` packages resolve their dependencies from their
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- The browser half registers into the composer's named model seat
(`conversation.input.model`) with "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"a shadowing priority, and into the
settings panel (`settings.section`).
- Model data comes from the "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"harness itself: the picker reads the same
per-session advisory directory the shipped picker uses (th"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"e
`modelDirectories` service), and the settings page fetches the global
catalog through the Remote A"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"PI (`remote.session.modelCatalog`). The plugin adds no
model data of its own — if a model is missing"},{"id":"p19s6","text":" from the picker, it is missing
from your configured provider catalogs (see below).
- Curation (hidd"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"en models + pinned order) is **persisted durably on your
machine**: the node half registers a `model"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"-picker-augmented` settings
namespace, and every change is written through the harness settings syst"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"em
into `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` (`model-picker-augmented: { hidden: …,
pinned: … }`), so your pins an"},{"id":"p19s10","text":"d hidden models survive page refreshes,
browser restarts, and machine restarts. On startup the brows"},{"id":"p19s11","text":"er half hydrates
the picker from that stored value.
- **Refresh providers** (settings page) runs in "},{"id":"p19s12","text":"two stages, only when you click it:
1. **Sync the harness with `settings.yaml`.** It issues a no-op "},{"id":"p19s13","text":"write
through the settings commit API to the plugin's own
`model-picker-augmented` namespace. Every "},{"id":"p19s14","text":"settings write forces the
harness to re-read `settings.yaml` from disk before persisting, and any
fi"},{"id":"p19s15","text":"le that has drifted — providers or models added by hand while the
harness was running — is re-publis"},{"id":"p19s16","text":"hed through the normal settings
pipeline, so their routes are re-registered **live, without a restar"},{"id":"p19s17","text":"t**.
Only the plugin's curation section is rewritten; every other section of
the file passes through"},{"id":"p19s18","text":" untouched (comments included). If this step
fails, the refresh continues with the in-memory catalog"},{"id":"p19s19","text":" and reports
`settings.yaml sync failed: …`.
2. **Re-read the catalog and sync the endpoints.** It t"},{"id":"p19s20","text":"hen fetches
`remote.session.modelCatalog` (catalog + per-provider failures),
`remote.llm.listProvide"},{"id":"p19s21","text":"rs` and `remote.llm.listConfigurableProviders`
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## DSH 0.1.5 compatibility (1.1.2)"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Version 1.1.1 used the removed `connection.api` browser interface and could
stop the DSH GUI with “C"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"annot read properties of undefined (reading settings)”.
Version 1.1.2 declares the scoped `remote.se"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ttings`, `remote.llm`, and
`remote.session` dependencies and uses their current methods, positional
"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"arguments and Result values. Pins and hidden models retain their existing
settings namespace and for"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ments and Result values. Pins and hidden models retain their existing
settings namespace and format."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Run `pnpm test` for regression coverage of client initialization, curation
writes, provider discover"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"y, revision-checked model additions and catalog
errors. Tests use an in-memory settings service and "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"never access credentials
or live model endpoints."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Verified on 2026-09-10 with DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 and Chromium 152: the complete
DSH GUI loads without plug"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"in failures, composer search filters models, the
settings catalog renders, and a pin survives a page"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" reload. The temporary
test pin was removed and the original curation settings were verified intact."}],"truncated":true}
